prompt: What components do I need for a basic satellite uplink command system? I want to be able to send commands from a ground station to a satellite, have the satellite validate them, execute them, and send back confirmation. Not looking for a super detailed architecture, just want to understand the main pieces before I start coding.

assertions.text: Identifies command lifecycle: creation → validation → encoding → transmission → reception → execution → confirmation
Lists 4-6 main components with clear responsibilities
Emphasizes validation as a critical component for safety
Suggests starting simple (direct delivery) before adding RF link simulation
Mentions encoding (even if simplified initially) and confirmation telemetry
Keeps response concise and appropriate for 'basic' request—not over-engineered
